_desc: Egress Web Filtering — 지정 도메인만 허용(ALLOWLIST). 나머지 egress 차단.
_usage: jq 'with_entries(select(.key|startswith("_")|not))' allowlist.json > rg.json && aws network-firewall create-rule-group --rule-group-name lab-nfw-allow --type STATEFUL --capacity 100 --rule-group file://rg.json  # ★ _-prefixed 주석 키를 먼저 제거
